UADataType.Description: The state reported for a recoverable Service operation. Unknown is a lookup result, not a stored execution outcome.

Field.Name: Unknown
Field.Description: No record is disclosed for this lookup. This does not establish whether work ran or may still be admitted.

Field.Name: Pending
Field.Description: The operation is admitted and has no committed final outcome.

Field.Name: OutcomeAvailable
Field.Description: An immutable original response or terminal protocol outcome is available.

Field.Name: Acknowledged
Field.Description: The Client acknowledged the available outcome and its payload was released.

Field.Name: Abandoned
Field.Description: The Client waived result recovery. This state does not establish that work stopped.

Field.Name: Expired
Field.Description: The result-retention interval elapsed and its payload was released.

UADataType.Description: The kind of committed outcome. A protocol outcome does not fabricate an original Service response.

Field.Name: None
Field.Description: No final outcome is reported.

Field.Name: ServiceResponse
Field.Description: The original Service produced a complete response or ServiceFault.

Field.Name: ExecutionDeadlineExceeded
Field.Description: The execution allowance ended before an outcome was committed. Effects may remain unknown.

Field.Name: ResultUnavailable
Field.Description: The original response could not be retained within the accepted encoding or message limits.

Field.Name: ExecutionIndeterminate
Field.Description: Restart recovery found durable admission without a committed final outcome. No redispatch occurs; effects remain unknown.

UADataType.Description: The disposition of a well-formed, authorized control request.

Field.Name: Unspecified
Field.Description: Invalid in a response.

Field.Name: Applied
Field.Description: The requested state change or cancellation signal was applied.

Field.Name: AlreadyApplied
Field.Description: The same action was applied previously; no new change was made.

Field.Name: NotApplicable
Field.Description: The action cannot be applied to the reported state; no new change was made.

Field.Name: UnknownOperation
Field.Description: No record is disclosed for the token; this is not proof of earlier acknowledgement or non-execution.

UADataType.Description: An action recorded by the privileged operation audit.

Field.Name: Admitted
Field.Description: Identity and resources were committed before dispatch.

Field.Name: OutcomeCommitted
Field.Description: An immutable outcome became available.

Field.Name: CancellationRequested
Field.Description: A cancellation signal was recorded; stopping is not asserted.

Field.Name: Acknowledged
Field.Description: The available outcome was acknowledged.

Field.Name: Abandoned
Field.Description: The result was abandoned.

Field.Name: Expired
Field.Description: The result-retention interval ended.

Field.Name: Rejected
Field.Description: Submission was rejected without a new dispatch.

Field.Name: Denied
Field.Description: A request was denied by authorization or Session checks.

Field.Name: Collected
Field.Description: An available outcome was selected for delivery.

Field.Name: SessionClosed
Field.Description: The issuing Session ended. Only Session-mode recoverable state is discarded.

Field.Name: HistoryForgotten
Field.Description: The bounded terminal record was removed.

Field.Name: InvocationEnded
Field.Description: Owned invocation resources were released after the invocation actually ended, possibly after a protocol deadline.

Field.Name: RestartRecovered
Field.Description: A durable record was recovered without original-request redispatch.

Field.Name: ExecutionIndeterminate
Field.Description: A durable admission without a committed final outcome was resolved to an indeterminate outcome.

UADataType.Description: The explicitly selected ownership and persistence contract. Higher modes include the lower mode's recovery guarantees, not its Session-bound ownership.

Field.Name: Unspecified
Field.Description: Invalid for submission or lookup. Used only in Unknown metadata.

Field.Name: Session
Field.Description: Recovery requires the issuing Session and validated creator; Session closure releases recoverable state.

Field.Name: Owner
Field.Description: A stable authenticated application-and-user owner may recover through a replacement Session. Restart survival is not promised.

Field.Name: Durable
Field.Description: Owner-scoped recovery with durable admission, immutable outcomes and release history across supported restarts; interrupted execution is not resumed.

UADataType.Description: Operation identity, state and remaining intervals. It contains no original response payload.

Field.Name: ClientOperationId
Field.Description: The accepted Client ID. An unknown Client-ID lookup echoes the requested ID; an unknown token lookup reports a null Guid.

Field.Name: ServerToken
Field.Description: The opaque token, between 1 and 64 bytes for a known record; null for an unknown lookup.

Field.Name: ServiceId
Field.Description: The DataType NodeId of the original request, or a null NodeId for an unknown lookup.

Field.Name: RecoveryMode
Field.Description: The exact accepted mode for a known record; Unspecified for Unknown metadata.

Field.Name: State
Field.Description: The disclosed operation state or Unknown lookup result.

Field.Name: OutcomeKind
Field.Description: The committed outcome kind; None while pending or unknown.

Field.Name: OutcomeStatus
Field.Description: The original serviceResult for ServiceResponse, or the terminal protocol error. Good with OutcomeKind None carries no business-success claim.

Field.Name: ExecutionAllowance
Field.Description: The accepted execution allowance in milliseconds; zero for an unknown lookup.

Field.Name: ResultRetentionTime
Field.Description: The accepted result and subsequent history interval in milliseconds; zero for an unknown lookup.

Field.Name: ExecutionRemaining
Field.Description: Nonnegative remaining execution allowance while Pending; otherwise zero.

Field.Name: ResultRemaining
Field.Description: Nonnegative remaining result retention while OutcomeAvailable; otherwise zero.

Field.Name: HistoryRemaining
Field.Description: Nonnegative remaining terminal-history retention after release; otherwise zero.

Field.Name: CancellationRequested
Field.Description: A cancellation signal has been requested. This is not confirmation that work stopped.

Field.Name: RetryAfter
Field.Description: Nonnegative advisory delay while Pending, no greater than ExecutionRemaining and strictly less than ResultRetentionTime when positive; zero for every other state.

UADataType.Description: Submit one eligible original Service request under the recoverable contract.

Field.Name: ClientOperationId
Field.Description: A fresh nonzero random Client operation ID.

Field.Name: RecoveryMode
Field.Description: Session, Owner or Durable. The Server honours this exact mode or rejects before dispatch.

Field.Name: Request
Field.Description: An ExtensionObject containing exactly one eligible original Service request.

Field.Name: ExecutionAllowance
Field.Description: Requested positive finite execution budget in milliseconds, starting at admission.

Field.Name: ResultRetentionTime
Field.Description: Exact positive finite milliseconds of result retention, then the same interval for terminal history.

Field.Name: WaitTime
Field.Description: Nonnegative finite maximum completion wait starting at admission commit; excludes admission and response delivery. Zero does not park a waiter.

UADataType.Description: The admitted operation state and any available original response.

Field.Name: Operation
Field.Description: The admitted identity, exact lifetime values and state.

Field.Name: Result
Field.Description: The immutable complete original response when State is OutcomeAvailable and OutcomeKind is ServiceResponse; otherwise a null ExtensionObject.

UADataType.Description: Recover or collect an operation using exactly one identifier.

Field.Name: RecoveryMode
Field.Description: Selects the Session or stable-owner lookup scope and exact recorded mode; not a request to change it.

Field.Name: ClientOperationId
Field.Description: A nonzero Client ID for recovery, or a null Guid when ServerToken is used.

Field.Name: ServerToken
Field.Description: A nonempty token of at most 64 bytes, or null when ClientOperationId is used. Supplying both or neither is invalid.

Field.Name: WaitTime
Field.Description: Nonnegative finite maximum completion wait starting when authorized lookup first finds Pending; excludes lookup and response delivery. Zero means polling.

UADataType.Description: A declared collection response containing state and an optional original response.

Field.Name: Operation
Field.Description: The operation snapshot or Unknown lookup result.

Field.Name: Result
Field.Description: The immutable complete original response when State is OutcomeAvailable and OutcomeKind is ServiceResponse; otherwise a null ExtensionObject.

UADataType.Description: Identify one operation for Acknowledge, Cancel or Abandon. The invoked Method selects the action.

Field.Name: ServerToken
Field.Description: A nonempty Server token of at most 64 bytes; Client ID lookup is not a control action.

UADataType.Description: The disposition of a control action and the resulting operation metadata.

Field.Name: Result
Field.Description: Whether the action was applied, already applied, not applicable or unknown.

Field.Name: Operation
Field.Description: The current disclosed metadata. This response never carries an original response payload.

UAObjectType.Description: Privileged aggregate diagnostics. There is no caller-visible operation list.

UAVariable.Description: Owned invocations that have not actually ended, including those past their protocol deadline.
Outcomes still available for collection.
Charged retained-outcome storage, including storage still leased to in-flight senders.
Retained metadata records after payload release, including required still-running-work identities.
Cumulative admitted operations.
Cumulative submissions rejected without a new dispatch.
Cumulative first acknowledgements; retries do not increase this count.
Cumulative first abandonments; retries do not increase this count.
Cumulative result-retention expirations.
Cumulative committed execution-deadline outcomes.
Cumulative indeterminate outcomes committed during durable restart recovery; not a count of proved business failures.

UAObjectType.Description: Privileged audit metadata for recoverable operation actions. Tokens, credentials and copied request/result payloads are not fields of this event.

UAVariable.Description: The Client correlation ID, or a null Guid when no operation was identified.
The original request DataType NodeId, when known.
The action recorded by this event.
The reported operation state or Unknown when no record is disclosed.
The recorded outcome kind, without the original response payload.
The original serviceResult or terminal protocol error when known; the inherited audit Status reports success of the audited action separately.
The recorded recovery mode when known; Unspecified for an undisclosed record.
